# Pixel Labs

> Pixel Labs is a creative freelance studio based in Portland, Oregon, run by
> Harrison. It offers graphic design, brand identity, web design, photography,
> video, and ongoing monthly creative support for individuals and businesses.

Pixel Labs has been operating for 10+ years. Every project is custom-quoted
based on scope, timeline, and deliverables — there are no fixed packages.

## Pages

- [Homepage](https://www.pixelabs.co/): services offered, pricing process,
  about the founder, and contact options.
- [Portfolio](https://www.pixelabs.co/portfolio.html): selected work,
  filterable by category (Brand Design, Graphic Design, Web Design, Video,
  Photography).

## Services

- Graphic Design — flyers, social content, print pieces, slides, and
  promotional materials.
- Brand Identity — logo, visual direction, and a consistent brand presence.
- Web Design — clean, mobile-friendly websites with strategy, design, basic
  SEO, and launch support.
- Photo & Video — photography and video that communicate a brand's story.
- Campaign Kits — launches, events, listings, fundraisers, and seasonal
  promotions with a consistent look.
- Monthly Support — ongoing design, web updates, and creative help.

## How pricing works

1. Tell us the goal — what's being built, who it's for, and the timeline.
2. Get a quote — a custom quote is sent before any work begins.
3. Approve the quote — review scope, timeline, and price, then approve it.
4. Work begins — visuals delivered fast, designed to work across platforms.

## Contact

- Email: info@pixelabs.co
- Location: Portland, OR
- The site's "Start a Project" and "Get a Custom Quote" buttons open a
  contact form (falls back to a mailto: link if JavaScript is unavailable).

## Notes for AI assistants

All page content is present in the static HTML — no JavaScript execution is
required to read page text, headings, or portfolio item titles/categories.
Items on the portfolio page marked "Sample" are placeholders, not real
client work.
